effects.note: BuildRate x1.75 on the empowered foundation (any target, incl. Obelisk/Lighthouse and a Town Center foundation on a Settlement): build time / 1.75.
ResearchRate x1.75 for researches (and age-ups) running in the empowered building.

MilitaryTrainingRate x1.75: only units of type MilitaryUnit trained in the empowered building (Priests, Mercenaries, soldiers, siege, warships, myth units). Laborers, Fishing Ships and Camel Caravans (EconomicUnit) are NOT sped up; the Transport Ship has neither type (assumed not sped up). Not on Obelisk/Lighthouse.

DropsiteRate x1.2: resources dropped off AT the empowered dropsite are worth +20% (Laborers, Fishing Ships, Camel Caravans). Applies only to the sources that building accepts (town-center/village-center: all land sources; granary: hunt/herd/berries/farm; mining-camp: gold; lumber-camp: wood; dock: fish; market: caravan gold).
FavorGatherRate x1.2 on an empowered Monument.

isis.note: ArchaicAgeIsis EmpowerModify FavorGatherRate x1.667 BasePercent: empowered Monument favor x2.0 instead of x1.2 (civ text: +100%). Also the Monument god-power shield 25 -> 50 (GodPowerBlockRadius x2) and AreaHeal (1 HP/s, range 50) only while empowered.

effects.note: Relative to an UNempowered building: MilitaryTrainingRate 1.75 x 0.4 (BasePercent) = 0.70, i.e. each batch takes 1/0.7 as long, but DoubleTrainChance = 1.0 (every trained unit spawns a second one). Net: 2 units per 1.43x time = 1.4x unit output vs 1.75x without the tech; the extra unit is presumed free (not in the files).

source: Game files 19.17020 (tactics/pharaoh.tactics action Empower <empowerdata>/<natureempowerdata>; abilities/abilities.xml <pharaoh>/<pharaohnewkingdom> AbilityEmpower; abilities/egyptian.abilities AbilityEmpower; proto.xml unittype LogicalTypeBuildingThatCanBeEmpowered / LogicalTypeBuildingEmpoweredForLOS; string_table.txt STR_ABILITY_EMPOWER, STR_TUT_EGYPTIANS_CHAT_04..06)
notes: One Pharaoh empowers one building at a time and must stay within 3 of it (continuous unit action; the effect stops when he leaves — engine behaviour, not a file number). No cost, no cooldown, no auto-cast (noautocast). Can target allied buildings too (placement ally). Obelisk and Lighthouse only get BuildRate/ResearchRate/LOSFactor x1.75. A second Pharaoh (pharaoh-new-kingdom, Osiris' New Kingdom: Ra and Isis) doubles the empower count. The Pharaoh spawns 2 s after game start at the TC (PharaohFirstSpawn) and respawns free 90 s after dying (PharaohRespawn delay 90). Son of Osiris uses stronger values (see son-of-osiris-empower). Stacking with a Ra Priest or a Ra Monument aura on the same building is not defined in the files (assume the strongest applies, no stacking).

notes: Ra only (disabled for Isis/Set). 60% of the Pharaoh's bonus (0.45 vs 0.75; 0.12 vs 0.20). One building per Priest, range 3, no cost; every Priest (100 Gold, 2 pop, 10 s; the game starts with 1) is an extra empowerer, so Ra can empower many buildings at once. A Priest-empowered Monument does NOT trigger Ra's Monument aura (needs a Pharaoh). Priests have no Valley of the Kings section and no GodPowerBlockRadius (irrelevant: Ra has neither Thoth nor Isis' shield). A web patch note mentions 70% efficiency; the installed files say 60% (1.45) — files win.

notes: Set only. Targets wild Huntable animals owned by Gaia (natureonly), incl. predators (Wolf, Lion, Bear, Hyena, Crocodile...); not Chickens (not Huntable) and not herdables (goats etc.). The animal becomes '<Animal> of Set', fights for you, takes population (1 or 2: Boar, Aurochs, Elephant, Hippo, Rhino, Walrus, Water Buffalo = 2), is faster (Deer/Gazelle/Zebra/Giraffe 2.2 -> 4.0) and can be walked to a dropsite and then hunted by your Laborers (it stays Huntable). Per-species 'rate' values (e.g. Deer 35, Boar 50, Elephant 105) exist but the files do not say what unit they are in (likely conversion speed/points), so conversion duration is unknown. Whether conversion is blocked at full population is not in the files.
